prompt: Which statements about Sentinel are correct?
explanation: Sentinels run as separate processes, typically three or more on separate machines; they keep monitoring masters and replicas; they promote a replica when a master fails; and clients ask Sentinel which node currently plays the master role. Quorum only decides when a master is objectively down — the failover itself still needs authorization from the Sentinel majority, so lowering quorum to 1 does not remove that requirement.

options.text: Sentinels are separate processes that continuously monitor masters and replicas
Sentinel automatically promotes a replica to master when the master fails
Setting quorum to 1 removes the need for Sentinel majority agreement on the failover
Clients can ask Sentinel for the current address of a service's master
